convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'wlxBW5Zone' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all position open/close logic and money management

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator readiness
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open functions

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: Up signal triggers SELL_Close, Dn signal triggers BUY_Close
Historical bar scan: if both open and close are enabled but no close signal on SignalBar, scans older bars (SignalBar+1 to Bars-1) for close signals from opposite zone

params.LOSSFREEMARGIN_mode: MM fraction of free margin minus floating loss
params.LOSSBALANCE_mode: MM fraction of balance minus floating loss

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size using MM value; FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=MM as fractional percentage of respective margin/balance base

custom_logic_notes: The EA scans historical bars beyond SignalBar to find close signals when both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled and no close signal was found on the current SignalBar. This backward scan (bar = SignalBar+1 to Bars-1) looks for the first opposite zone signal to trigger position closure. Signal time is computed as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, effectively the open time of the next bar. The 'Dir' input (ON/OFF) controls the custom indicator's directional mode. The Recount flag ensures signals are recalculated on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are all independent toggleable booleans allowing asymmetric open/close behavior.
python_conversion_notes: The wlxBW5Zone custom indicator must be reimplemented or its algorithm reverse-engineered before conversion - it provides two buffers (0=DnValue, 1=UpValue) where non-zero/non-EMPTY_VALUE signals zone entry. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with money management, deviation handling, and GlobalVariable management - all must be reimplemented. The MarginMode enum (5 modes) and the MM+MMMode parameter interaction needs careful translation. The IsNewBar class (CIsNewBar) and LoadHistory helper also come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh. Signal time calculation uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + PeriodSeconds for next-bar-open execution assumption. The backward bar scan for close signals (lines 142-168) is a unique pattern that must be preserved exactly.
